account_isolation: RuntimeApp still clears/binds the volatile session on verified identity/permission revision changes and unmounts private UI during revalidation. No additional concrete cross-account leak identified in that integration.

findings.evidence: submit freezes active directly without a fresh client.get/getContext. Its guard and disabled button use busy/checking but not pending/blocked.
findings.impact: A development submission can use an old revision or the pre-uncertain-write context. Production execution remains unavailable until C20, whose server-side reauthorization is still required.
findings.recommendation: Before submission, freshly load and validate current C17 context/status and conversation under an operation guard. If the binding changed, update the displayed context and require review/resubmit. Block new submission while a context mutation is pending.
findings.title: Submission still uses the last polled context rather than a fresh current C17 binding
findings.trigger: Another chat changes scope/pins or a current source policy withdraws a selection after the last poll; alternatively a context write is uncertain and pending but busy is false. Submit is then pressed.

findings.evidence: navigate always setBusy(false), even when investigation/conversation and thus guard.current are unchanged. runAction only checks busy, and its controls are likewise enabled from busy.
findings.impact: The old operation is still active but run controls can start overlapping requests; completion/finally from the earlier request can update shared state or clear a newer request busy state.
findings.recommendation: Keep busy ownership tied to a synchronous operation token/ref. Presentation-only navigation must not end that ownership; selection changes should explicitly invalidate or move pending work.
findings.title: Presentation-only navigation clears an active request busy state
findings.trigger: While a slow context mutation or run request is awaiting a response, switch Workspace tabs or Chat/Workspace panes, or open evidence.

findings.evidence: Malformed restore clears active and sets located=false but leaves the existing location/guard key unchanged and does not invalidate mutation/run work. The mutation result checks mounted and equality of this reusable string before applying fresh context. The same string is reused on A-to-B-to-A navigation.
findings.impact: A delayed mutation can repopulate private active context after malformed navigation blocked it. A delayed run result can overwrite newer state after returning to the same conversation.
findings.recommendation: Use a monotonic selection/request generation, invalidate and abort on malformed restoration and real selection changes, and require generation ownership before committing any async result or clearing busy.
findings.title: Reusable selection-key guard allows stale in-flight results after invalid URL or A-to-B-to-A navigation
findings.trigger: Start a slow mutation, restore a malformed history URL, then let the request finish. Or leave a conversation and return to the same conversation before an earlier run status response returns.
